purpose: Define each concrete attempt of a request as a distinct identity linked to request, prior attempts and retry policy.

topics.name: Execution Attempt Identity
topics.purpose: Define each concrete attempt of a request as a distinct identity linked to request, prior attempts and retry policy.

semantics.identity_rule: Each execution attempt has a distinct attempt identity.
semantics.sequence_rule: Attempt ordinal is explicit evidence, not identity by itself.
semantics.prior_rule: Retry attempts reference prior failure/attempt where applicable.
semantics.result_rule: Each attempt has its own status/result/error evidence.
semantics.accepted_rule: At most the explicitly allowed effect acceptance semantics determine which attempt produced accepted effect.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: attempt ordinal alone used globally as identity
